name: CN113162215B Emergency power supply system and control method for replacing offshore platform diesel generator system
notes: Patent read in the WHP sweep: Emergency power supply system and control method for replacing offshore platform diesel generator system; assignee PowerChina Huadong Engineering Corp Ltd; Priority 2021-04-01, granted 2023-06-02; auxiliary fire control uses photoelectric smoke and photoelectric temperature detection plus a fire-detector tube; emergency loads include platform fire alarm and fire broadcasting equipment Page read 2026-11-24.
